% Pattern: counter/equation. A theorem numbered with the equations counts one
% number for an align whose rows are in a split, or in cases, and one number
% for each row of an align of its own.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 1.6
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\newtheorem{lem}[equation]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{Trees}
\begin{lem} Each tree with two vertices or more has a leaf. \end{lem}
\begin{align}
\begin{split}
 a &= b \\
   &= c
\end{split}
\end{align}
\begin{align}
 f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & x > 0 \\ 0 & x \le 0 \end{cases}
\end{align}
\begin{align}
 x &= y \\
 y &= z \nonumber \\
 z &= w
\end{align}
\begin{lem} Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. \end{lem}
\end{document}
